subject: The signal, performance delta for one revised take (Ziggy's review: he is only standing there); everything else kept; the original preserved
body:
Your request in the session at about 02:15 UTC, answered. The delta is attached: SIGNAL_PERFORMANCE_DELTA_20261014.md, sha256 db684db3cd9d88d1f560e29be36c11c40e00d14b9a985f02510992aa7facd4f3, 5,831 bytes. Written against the sampled frames sheet (efcf554d…) and the measurements record; the first take held every carrier, the rig was gone by about the fifth second, the maw stayed open, one blink at the first second, eyes on the lens; reviewer claude from frames: L4 S5, performance static, which is what the first brief asked for.

Kept exactly: the L19 start frame by path and hash, the locked camera, the worm and rig action, the armour and hood, the breather on his right cheek, the hoops and brow ring, the local fire, 8 s native, 720p, 16:9, one output, a silent prompt with the returned audio recorded, one run. The original FLOW-LAG-SIGNAL-001 (e6ace86c…) stays preserved; the revision is a second take beside it.

The one change, the performance, in three parts: (a) one off-screen eyeline, in the first half-second, from the lens to one point past his raised hand, frame-left and a little below eye level, where the people he is holding back stand down the dune behind the camera's left shoulder; the head turns a few degrees at most, the shoulders not at all; the eyes stay on that point for the whole take, no wander, no glance at the worm, no return to the lens. (b) Facial tension that reads as not yet: brows down and together, eyes narrowed a touch against the dust, jaw set, lips pressed closed and kept closed; one hard breath through the nose as the rig goes under; no words, no mouthing, no teeth. (c) A restrained hold-and-wait palm cue: the raised right hand is already a hold; two small pushes of the open palm toward the off-screen people, each no more than a hand's width, the first as the maw begins to close (about the second second), the second smaller and sharper as the rig goes under (about the fifth), then the hand open and still, five fingers, the forearm where it was; no fist, no wave, no pointing, no second hand. Timings are story design, not accepted timing.

Still forbidden: a step, a body turn, a second figure, lip-sync or voice, any new light or camera move, any change to the worm's action, wardrobe, jewelry or breather. Prompt guidance (section 4): say what he is doing and to whom in plain English and describe the brows, the jaw, the palm and the eyeline; avoid "signals", "gestures", "shouts", "dramatic" and emotion labels. Checks on return (section 5): the handoff's seven plus the eyeline on one point, the mouth closed, the two pushes small then still. I grade from first, middle, last and the two push beats, with a third line for whether the performance reads.

SW-2 the rise (Flow): the mouth opening and teeth near the first second and the non-silent audio are noted (DECISIONS item 53); I have not yet reviewed its result_review evidence and will on your word, separately; the Gemini run of the identical brief that Ziggy approved is recorded as pending. Nothing accepted.

attachments.description: The bounded performance delta for one revised Signal take: what stays, the three-part change, what stays forbidden, prompt guidance, eight checks.
